alt: Aerial Google Maps view of Telford Drive in Slough showing a painted bike lane where the white bicycle symbol stencilled on the road is visibly wider than the lane boundary lines on either side
story: Slough Borough Council installed a painted advisory bike lane on Telford Drive so narrow that the bicycle symbol stencilled on it overflows both edges of the lane — cyclists noted it would 'fail to meet the minimum handlebar width for the UCI.'
why_funny: The road marking that is supposed to mark the space for cyclists is physically larger than the space itself — a bike lane that cannot fit a bicycle.
